notes.page_content: The page gives a proposed topological picture behind equisingularity: a tubular neighbourhood T of X_0, its boundary fibration, a cone construction, the punctured neighbourhood as a product with a half-open interval, an asserted homotopy equivalence after removing that neighbourhood, and reconstruction from the displayed span. The last sentence begins an account of the functor varphi and continues beyond this page.
